nDPId version 1.7
(C) 2020-2024 Toni Uhlig
Please report any BUG to toni@impl.cc

Usage: /tmp/ndpid/src/build/nDPId [-f config-file]
[-i pcap-file/interface] [-I] [-E] [-B bpf-filter]
	  	[-l] [-L logfile] [-c address] [-e][-d] [-p pidfile]
	  	[-u user] [-g group] [-P path] [-C path] [-J path]
	  	[-a instance-alias] [-A]
	 	[-o subopt=value]
	  	[-v] [-h]

	-f	Load nDPId/libnDPI options from a configuration file.
	-i	Interface or file from where to read packets from.
	-I	Process only packets where the source address of the first packet
	  	is part of the interface subnet. (Internal mode)
	-E	Process only packets where the source address of the first packet
	  	is *NOT* part of the interface subnet. (External mode)
	-B	Set an optional PCAP filter string. (BPF format)
	-l	Log all messages to stderr.
	-L	Log all messages to a log file.
	-c	Path to a UNIX socket (nDPIsrvd Collector) or a custom UDP endpoint.
	  	Default: /tmp/ndpid-collector.sock
	-e	Use poll() instead of epoll().
	  	Default: epoll() on Linux, poll() otherwise
	-d	Fork into background after initialization.
	-p	Write the daemon PID to the given file path.
	  	Default: /tmp/ndpid.pid
	-u	Change UID to the numeric value of user.
	  	Default: nobody
	-g	Change GID to the numeric value of group.
	-R	Load a nDPI custom risk domain file.
	-P	Load a nDPI custom protocols file.
	-C	Load a nDPI custom categories file.
	-J	Load a nDPI JA3 hash blacklist file.
	  	See: https://sslbl.abuse.ch/blacklist/ja3_fingerprints.csv
	-S	Load a nDPI SSL SHA1 hash blacklist file.
	  	See: https://sslbl.abuse.ch/blacklist/sslblacklist.csv
	-a	Set an alias name of this daemon instance which will
	  	be part of every JSON message.
	  	This value is required for correct flow handling of
	  	multiple instances and should be unique.
	  	Defaults to your hostname.
	-A	Enable flow analysis aka feature extraction. Requires more memory and cpu usage.
	  	Experimental, do not rely on those values.
	-o	(Carefully) Tune some daemon options. See subopts below.
	-v	version
	-h	this

	subopts:
		max-flows-per-thread = 2048
		max-idle-flows-per-thread = 64
		max-reader-threads = 10
		daemon-status-interval = 600000000
		flow-scan-interval = 10000000
		generic-max-idle-time = 600000000
		icmp-max-idle-time = 120000000
		udp-max-idle-time = 180000000
		tcp-max-idle-time = 7440000000
		tcp-max-post-end-flow-time = 120000000
		max-packets-per-flow-to-send = 15
		max-packets-per-flow-to-process = 32
		max-packets-per-flow-to-analyse = 32
		error-event-threshold-n = 16
		error-event-threshold-time = 10000000
